verdict.rationale: Vanta documents a first-party AI Agent offering agentic search and natural-language questions across policies, controls, frameworks, tests, and documents. The agent also drafts policies and completes questionnaires. Separately, an official MCP server lets assistants like Claude, Cursor, and Perplexity query controls, list failing tests, generate remediation plans, and act on compliance data from natural-language prompts. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of either feature, and clear documentation of how far the in-app agent goes beyond querying and drafting into general product operation.
